cells.gaps: No source held since October 2023 says a financial ombudsman or complaints unit takes complaints; the mediation scheme was to launch on 26 October 2026.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-10-26: The mediation framework under CEMAC Regulation 01/20, made national by a 2024 decree and two January 2025 orders, covers payment institutions and mobile money, which answers question 2. The mediator's launch on 26 October 2026 is not yet on record as taking complaints.
